content: flashrom write-protection CLI grammar: a dedicated --wp-* option family: --wp-status (report current WP state + range + mode), --wp-enable, --wp-disable, --wp-range, --wp-region. Critically, flashrom 'automatically tries to disable WP before any operation on a chip' - i.e. silent auto-unlock is flashrom's default too, with WP state exposed via a separate read-only status command rather than in the write output. Docs warn users to double-check status separately because the auto-disable is implicit.
